name: Picture, clip and narration
description: Makes a picture, sets it moving, reads your words aloud, and joins them into one finished clip.

inputs.name: picture
inputs.label: Describe the picture
inputs.place: A lighthouse at dusk, fog rolling in, one warm window

inputs.name: motion
inputs.label: What moves in the clip
inputs.place: The fog drifts slowly, and the light in the window flickers

inputs.name: words
inputs.label: Words to read aloud
inputs.place: Every night for forty years, someone climbed these stairs.

inputs.name: length
inputs.label: Length of the clip
inputs.help: If the words run longer, the last frame holds until they finish.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.label: Starting number
inputs.help: Leave blank for a new one. Every picture starts from a random number. The same number and words make the same picture again.
